context: Applied contracts 3.0.0-draft.3 and the merge-time fixes: scopeAuthorizes adopted, optional superseded.by, legacy post entry_type, new delivery reasons, exchangeStatus on the store API, RetrievalAnnex moved, correctionFor conflicts, gitignore, offline switch, calibration script, doc counts.
rationale: Left plugin/BEHAVIORS.md untouched. Its header says 35 tools while it documents 37, and four registry tools are undocumented (twining_amend, twining_triage predate this work; twining_exchange_status and twining_migrate_status are new). Editing plugin/ forces a plugin version bump and bundle rebuild under the CI plugin-version-check, which is a release action this merge should not take. Recorded as an open follow-up instead.
